content.comment_body: Hello, Which SCADA platforms are compatible with [product_name] [version_no] PLC?

[product_name] (TIA-Portal) version 11 or newer, as well as [product_name] flexible, are suitable options. For additional reference, you can visit [url], where examples of communication between [product_name] and HMI devices are provided.
I was able to establish a connection using Modbus TCP/IP.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for SCADA solutions that are compatible with [product_name] [version_no] PLCs and expect straightforward integration with HMIs or SCADA systems using common protocols. Suggestions point to [product_name] (including TIA-Portal and flexible versions) as valid options, and Modbus TCP/IP was mentioned as a working communication method.
